property.name: depart_text
property.value: You climb back toward the grey light of the mine mouth.

property.name: text
property.value:
Scratched into the board with a nail, the letters gone grey with age.

DEEP VEIN - SHUT.

Not for the copper. The copper ran out years back. Shut for the green, and for what's past it.

Something down there counts your steps. You walk, it clicks. You stand, it stops. I stood a long time.

- O.

property.name: title
property.value: A Board by the West Tunnel

property.name: hint
property.value: The air is dead still. Somewhere in the rock, something waits to hear you move.

property.name: text
property.value:
Letters cut deep and careful, by someone with time.

STAND. BREATHE. THEN WALK.

The arrows were not set for beasts. Beasts do not wait.

On the flat stones you may stand. Anywhere else, do not stop.

property.name: text
property.value:
Fourteen marks, then the same careful hand.

I was the King's sword in Arden. In the 14th year of King Lucas he gave me a village in the west and a child the stars had marked, and told me to come home alone.

I found the child. I drew. I did not cut.

A man who swears to a king swears to the king's hand. I broke that oath in a barn in the west, and I have kept the broken half ever since. Let them call the blade what they like.

I set the arrows in the long hall so that hunters who run will die and men who wait may pass. Lucas never sent a patient man.

If you are reading this, you waited. Take the sword. Draw it the way I learned to down here: once, and only when you are sure.

- Merek

property.name: key_got
property.value: Oathbreaker. Hold your attack and wait while the meter beside you fills, then release: the cut is drawn like his - far heavier, and it staggers.

property.name: text
property.value: A sheathed blade in plain grey steel, laid on the stone before a man who died sitting up. The seal on the scabbard was never broken.\n\nThe King's swordmaster carried it into the west to end a child. It came back out of the west unbloodied, and its master never came back at all.
